title: Mini-SGLang Part 4: Inside the Engine—Attention, CUDA Graphs, and Tensor Parallelism
question: How does a prepared batch produce the next token through attention, graph replay, tensor parallelism and token feedback?
scope: Dense Qwen3, FlashInfer, greedy TP1 golden path; TP2 extension, two decode steps; bounded full-SGLang configuration comparison.
assumptions: Token IDs, dimensions, addresses, logits choices and sample IDs are illustrative, not model outputs.
Allocator page size2; FlashInfer internal page view1.
Full SGLang comparison source f825d729363136a2d4a4b330fa694d0b37a878fa, configuration entry points only.
Five usable allocator pages, unlike Part3 four-page pressure example; extra page8,9 supplies two decode slots; maxseq10 allows output allowance4.

claims.statement: GPU input gather and sampled-token feedback are logical token_pool operations.
Qwen3 carries x and residual separately across attention and MLP.
Q/K head normalization precedes RoPE and backend attention.
FlashInfer stores current K/V before running attention on the cache.
Prefill selects the last query row per real request before vocabulary projection.
Model execution precedes request-counter advance, sampling, host copy and copy event.
Replay copies stable input buffers and prepares backend metadata, then returns only real rows.
The attention output projection all-reduces partial output contributions under TP.
CPU result handling synchronizes the copy event before reading host token IDs.
FlashInfer interprets the allocator cache as one-token pages and uses cumulative query/KV lengths.
Cache storage has separate K/V and layer axes, plus physical pages, slots, local KV heads and head width.
Graphs capture model forward and logits buffer writes for padded decode buckets; the Engine reserves a dummy page.
All-greedy uses argmax; non-all-greedy prepares temperature/top-k/top-p probability sampling.
Weights are sharded and merged, with replicated KV heads when TP exceeds KV heads in supported arrangements.
RoPE uses explicit absolute positions and restricts supported head sizes.
Residual addition is fused into normalization when a residual is present.
Merged gate/up activation multiplies the activated gate by up, then applies a row-parallel down projection.
Hardware predicates select auto backends; explicit comma-separated values select prefill/decode backends.

figures.caption: Packed suffix rows through Qwen3 with shapes and residual.
Token, position and slot maps with causal query visibility.
Bucket padding, stable inputs, backend updates and sampling after replay.

uncertainties: No CUDA, attention, model, graph or multi-GPU execution was performed.
Stochastic TP sampling agreement is not verified; no token broadcast in inspected Engine/Sampler path.
No direct regression coverage established for graph parity, prefix-hit attention, overlap ordering or TP output agreement.
